title: Pager memory classification and page reference observation

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerIsMemdb classifies temporary-file and mem-VFS-backed pagers as memory databases, while sqlite3PagerPageRefcount exposes the live page-cache reference count.

external_source_responsibilities: Page cache owns and updates the reference count
Pager construction sets temporary and memory-VFS identities
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete observation helpers are assigned and exercised against live Pager/CachedPage owners.

outputs: Memory-backed boolean or live reference count
contracts.state_and_results: Memory classification is temporary OR memory_vfs. Reference result is the exact cache-page references field.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns synchronization; no callbacks or I/O.

representation_differences: Zig returns usize and bool instead of C int. Temporary and memVfs fields are named temporary and memory_vfs.

oracle.protocol: Observe reference count 1 on a fetched page, then classify ordinary false, memory-VFS true, and temporary true states.
oracle.normalization: Booleans normalize to zero/nonzero and counts compare exactly.

integration.native_call_path: Temporary opening asserts memory classification; fetched-page ownership exposes exact references for B-tree and pager lifecycle decisions.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add pinned-C temp/mem-VFS and page-reference differential.

implementation_spans: src/core/internal/pager_core.zig Pager/CachedPage fields, temporary opening, get/unref paths, and tests were reviewed
callers: B-tree page reinitialization consumes page reference count in the source
Journal-mode and filename owners consume memory classification
Unit trace observes live Pager/CachedPage state
callees: Direct typed field observations in Zig
assertions_branches_cleanup: Both generated return blocks are assigned
Temporary and memory-VFS cases are independent OR operands
No allocation or cleanup paths exist
upstream_tests: Upstream pager, memdb, temp, pcache, and B-tree tests exercise these observations
Project pager core/differential suites exercise page ownership and memory-backed modes
